en: Not the same as another; or of many kinds.
ex: My brother and I have different tastes in music.
我哥哥和我的音樂品味不同。

en: Not easy to do or understand; needing a lot of effort.
ex: The math test was very difficult.
這次數學考試非常難。

en: To make a hole in the ground using your hands or a tool; or to search for something.
ex: The children dug a big hole in the sand.
孩子們在沙地上挖了一個大洞。

en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
ex: We have dinner at seven o'clock.
我們七點吃晚餐。

en: Not clean; covered with dirt; or unfair or immoral.
ex: Your shoes are dirty; please clean them.
你的鞋子很髒，請把它們擦乾淨。

en: A flat container for food; or a particular kind of food prepared in a certain way.
ex: She washed the dishes after dinner.
晚餐後她洗了碗盤。

en: To perform an action or activity; also used with other verbs to ask questions or make negatives.
ex: What do you do on weekends?
你週末都做什麼？

en: A person who is trained to treat sick or injured people; or a person with the highest university degree.
ex: You should see a doctor if you have a fever.
你發燒的話應該去看醫生。

en: A common animal that is kept as a pet or used for guarding and hunting.
ex: The dog barked at the stranger.
那隻狗對著陌生人吠叫。

en: A toy in the shape of a small person, often played with by children.
ex: The little girl hugged her doll tightly.
小女孩緊緊抱著她的洋娃娃。

en: The unit of money used in the United States, Canada and other countries.
ex: The book costs ten dollars.
這本書要十美元。

en: A flat piece of wood or glass that you open and close to enter or leave a room or building.
ex: Please close the door when you leave.
你離開時請關門。

en: Toward a lower place; or in a lower position; or feeling sad.
ex: Please sit down and take a rest.
請坐下休息一下。

en: A group of twelve things of the same kind.
ex: I bought a dozen eggs at the market.
我在市場買了一打雞蛋。

en: To make a picture with a pen or pencil; or to pull something toward you; or to attract.
ex: The child likes to draw pictures of animals.
那個孩子喜歡畫動物的圖畫。

en: A series of images and feelings in your mind while you sleep; or a hope for the future.
ex: I had a strange dream last night.
我昨晚做了一個奇怪的夢。

en: A piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body and legs; or to put clothes on.
ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
她穿著一件紅色洋裝去參加派對。

en: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it; or a liquid you drink.
ex: You should drink more water every day.
你每天應該多喝水。

en: To control a car, bus or truck; or to push someone or something to move; or a trip in a car.
ex: My father drives to work every day.
我爸爸每天開車上班。

en: A person who drives a car, bus or train; or a computer program that controls a device.
ex: The bus driver stopped to let the children cross.
公車司機停下來讓孩子們過馬路。

en: To fall or let something fall; or a small amount of liquid; or to stop doing something.
ex: Be careful not to drop the glass.
小心別把玻璃杯掉了。

en: A musical instrument you hit with sticks or hands; or a large round container for oil.
ex: He plays the drums in the school band.
他在學校樂隊裡打鼓。

en: Having no water or moisture on the surface; or to remove water from something.
ex: Hang the wet clothes outside to dry.
把濕衣服掛在外面晾乾。

en: A water bird with a flat beak and short legs; or to lower your head quickly to avoid something.
ex: The ducks swam across the pond.
鴨子游過了池塘。

en: Through the whole time of something; or at some point in a period.
ex: Please do not talk during the movie.
電影放映期間請勿交談。

en: Every one of two or more people or things, considered separately.
ex: Each student has a different book.
每個學生都有一本不同的書。

en: The part of your head that you hear with; or the top part of a plant such as corn.
ph: in one ear and out the other
ex: She whispered something in his ear.
她在他耳邊低語了些什麼。

en: Near the start of a period of time; or before the usual or expected time.
ex: I get up early every morning to study.
我每天早上很早起床讀書。

en: The planet we live on; or the soil in which plants grow.
ex: The earth moves around the sun.
地球繞著太陽轉。

en: The direction where the sun rises; or a place in that direction.
ex: The sun rises in the east.
太陽從東方升起。

en: Not difficult; needing little effort; or comfortable and relaxed.
ex: The test was easy, so everyone passed.
考試很簡單，所以大家都通過了。

en: To put food into your mouth and swallow it.
ex: We eat dinner together as a family.
我們全家一起吃晚餐。

en: An oval object laid by a hen and eaten as food; or a female cell from which a baby animal grows.
ex: I have two boiled eggs for breakfast.
我早餐吃兩顆水煮蛋。

en: One or the other of two; or used to mean 'too' in negative sentences.
ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
你可以喝茶或咖啡。

en: A very large gray animal with a long nose called a trunk and two large teeth called tusks.
ph: 眾所皆知卻避而不談的問題
ex: The elephant sprayed water over itself with its trunk.
大象用鼻子把水噴到自己身上。

en: Other or different; or if not.
ex: Would you like anything else to drink?
你還想喝點別的嗎？

en: A message sent from one computer to another through the internet.
ex: I will send you an email tomorrow.
我明天會寄電子郵件給你。

en: The last part of something; or to stop; or the point where something finishes.
ex: The movie ended at ten o'clock.
電影在十點結束。

en: A person whose job is to design, build or repair machines, roads, bridges or computer systems.
ex: My uncle is an engineer who builds bridges.
我叔叔是個建造橋梁的工程師。

en: To get pleasure from something.
ex: I enjoy listening to music in my free time.
我空閒時喜歡聽音樂。
